verdict.rationale: The evidence describes logged-in UTR/UTS services for resuming a registration, filing reports, and managing a tax account. None of it documents a way to look up the status of a filing, application, or case from TWC's public pages. Resuming an unfinished registration and managing an account are adjacent features, not status lookup.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
